blocks.text: What the Heart of Harmony Brochure Contains
The official Heart of Harmony brochure is a comprehensive document that covers the full scope of the project. Here is what you will find inside:
1. Project Overview & Developer Introduction

CKPC Properties’ philosophy and background — establishing Heart of Harmony as a landmark luxury development on Hosur Main Road. Covers Chirag Purushotam’s vision for low-density, high-rise living at one of Bengaluru’s most connected junctions.
2. Location Map & Connectivity Details

The location map in the brochure covers Heart of Harmony’s proximity to key destinations — metro access, employment hubs, schools, and hospitals. For the full location analysis with all landmark distances, connectivity guide, and area map, see our Heart of Harmony location guide .
Heart of Harmony’s location map is especially relevant for buyers seeking luxury apartments near Silk Board — the proximity to Silk Board Junction is one of the project’s strongest selling points.
3. Master Plan

Site layout including tower placement, vehicle-free podium-level amenity zones, 84% open green space, entry and exit points, and basement parking levels. This helps buyers visualise how the 137-unit development is organised across the site. For a detailed breakdown of the master plan, read the Heart of Harmony master plan guide .
4. Floor Plans

Unit-wise layouts for all three configurations with carpet area and approximate super built-up area details. Buyers evaluating premium 3 BHK and 4 BHK flats near HSR Layout will find the floor plan section especially relevant given Heart of Harmony’s proximity to the HSR Layout belt.

blocks.text: 6. Specifications Sheet

Material and fitting quality across flooring, walls, kitchen, bathrooms, doors, and electrical and plumbing systems. This is where you validate that the on-ground quality matches the premium pricing of the project.
7. Pricing & Payment Plans

Indicative pricing and payment plan structure. For the most current pricing, always request an updated cost sheet from the sales team at the time of your enquiry — under-construction project prices evolve as construction progresses. Read our complete Heart of Harmony price guide ] for how pricing works and what questions to ask.
How to Read a Project Brochure Intelligently
A brochure is a marketing document. Here is what experienced buyers look for beyond the visuals:

items: RERA number: Verify it at rera.karnataka.gov.in — confirms registration and shows all RERA-approved plans
Carpet area vs super built-up area: Price per sq ft on carpet area is the only fair basis for comparison across projects
Possession date: Cross-check with RERA documents for the committed timeline (Heart of Harmony: March 2030)
Specifications: Look for brand names — branded fixtures are harder to substitute during construction
Payment schedule: Confirm whether it is construction-linked (RERA-aligned) or time-based

items.q: Is Heart of Harmony RERA registered?
